findings.title: Dev seeding is broken by the Bun switch and still exits 0
findings.evidence: raw/baseline-database-reset-2-missing-yarn-assets.txt shows ENOENT for dist/assets/.../seed-dependencies/yarn.lock; the seed left 0 workspaces and 0 users while the reset script exited 0. Commit 1bf3ec682f deleted three yarn asset files that runtime code still reads (source: get-default-application-package-fields.util.ts line 25 reads seed-dependencies/yarn.lock).
findings.workaround: restored the three files from a431f9a into ignored dist/assets only (reproduce.sh restore_baseline_yarn_assets)
findings.smallestFollowUp: Restore or replace the three assets and make the seed command fail loudly.

findings.title: Built server cannot start: undeclared dependency google-auth-library
findings.evidence: raw/baseline-database-reset-1-missing-google-auth-library.txt shows MODULE_NOT_FOUND from google-messaging-notification.handler.js. findings.title: Preview edit is broken against the current Convex mutation
findings.evidence: workspaceCompanies.update requires expectedRevision (workspaceCompanies.ts line 224); the preview call at CompaniesWorkspace.tsx line 410 sends only workspaceId, companyId and the form values. tsgo reports TS2741 there. diagnostics/edit-payload-without-expected-revision.sh sends that payload shape to the real mutation: rejected with 'Missing required field expectedRevision' and the stored company is unchanged (raw/convex-edit-without-revision.txt).
findings.class: observed at the mutation boundary with the payload shape from the source; the rendered edit flow was not run because no authenticated preview session exists
findings.smallestFollowUp: Send the record's revision from the preview when saving, or finish the in-progress change; then add the edit step to the paired journey.
